decisions.reason: Document capture supports the firm's push toward electronic document workflows and digital business processes, though its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 raises some doubt.
Email-to-fax conversion is still used by regulated customers and costs little to run on the existing infrastructure, but fax demand keeps declining.

This fax optimization feature is cheap to maintain within the established fax service, although the shrinking fax market and its lack of visibility make it a candidate for folding into the base offer.
Sandbox threat protection meets growing demand for email security among compliance-focused customers and fits the firm's strategic direction.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a core part of the secure email service and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
